convention: All files are pre-normalized: +Z forward, +Y up, +X = vehicle left, meters, ground at y=0, x/z centered on the bounding box. Wheel nodes (wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr) are pivots at the wheel centers (axle along X); their meshes are children. Geometry uses EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization (GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)); textures are WebP (EXT_texture_webp).
